column1: # Golden Sun: Ashfall: Umbral Rift live narrative dialogue.
# Split into speech turns; each page max three lines, each line max 27 characters.
# ??? remains unidentified. Mia never calls Alex a cousin.

column3: That fountain...\nIt reminds me of\nMercury Lighthouse.{end_wait}
Yes. It looks so much\nlike the one there.{end_wait}
It really does look\nlike your house, Isaac.{end_wait}
Is this where you grew up?{end_wait}
Yes. For a moment,\nI thought Mom was here.{end_wait}
I know, Isaac.\nBut we're not in Vale.{end_wait}
Maybe it did something\nin another room.{end_wait}
Could the orb have\nopened a way through?{end_wait}
We still don't know\nhow it got here.{end_wait}
I recognized its power.\nI came to see\nwhat crossed over.{end_wait}
This place looks like\nparts of our own world.{end_wait}
Touch the walls.\nThey are real enough.{end_wait}
Another world.\nFragments of places\nit once held.{end_wait}
A passage between worlds\nwas opened.\nIt didn't close cleanly.{end_wait}
It holds the breach\nin one place.\nFor now.{end_wait}
The Rift may spread.\nVale could be next.{end_wait}
Not yet.\nI need to know\nif it can be used.{end_wait}
A way across worlds.\nMy people once had one.{end_wait}
Her Dark Psynergy\ncan sense weak points.\nI need her for that.{end_wait}
We saw figures like you.\nWhat were they?{end_wait}
Echoes of our passage.\nThe Rift left them behind.{end_wait}
Don't lie to me!\nI know those eyes!{end_wait}
You ruined my face!\nI can't even bear\nmy own reflection!{end_wait}
I'll kill you!\nI'll make you suffer!{end_wait}
My lady, please!\nLet me kill him!{end_wait}
And you're about\nto disobey me again.{end_wait}
Do you remember\nwhy I brought you here?{end_wait}
To find a way through.\nMy lady, please...{end_wait}
Because your power\nis still useful to me.\nNot because I trust you.{end_wait}
At the Apollo Lens,\nMatthew was to live.\nThat was my order.{end_wait}
Do you really think\nI didn't know?{end_wait}
Ace was Alex.\nHe fooled the others.\nHe never fooled me.{end_wait}
Kraden exposed his name\nat the Apollo Lens.\nI knew long before.{end_wait}
I knew Alex would turn.\nI was ready for him.{end_wait}
Then you and Spade\ntried to seize the Lens.\nFor yourselves.{end_wait}
You meant to take it.\nDon't insult me\nwith another lie!{end_wait}
You forced a battle\nI never ordered.\nAlex escaped.{end_wait}
You threw away\nmy chance to deal with him.\nDo you understand?{end_wait}
Then why do you\nstill blame Matthew?{end_wait}
Look what he did to me!{end_wait}
He fought back.\nYou chose that fight.\nYou chose to betray me.{end_wait}
When I learned what\nyou and Spade had done,\nI nearly killed you both.{end_wait}
Please don't kill me!\nI'll obey! I swear it!{end_wait}
You are alive because\nyou are still useful.\nThat is the only reason.{end_wait}
Know your place, Heart.\nOr you will die.{end_wait}
Forgive me!\nPlease forgive me!\nI'll never fail again!{end_wait}
Alex abandoned our clan.\nHe helped light\nMercury Lighthouse.{end_wait}
What do you know about\nAlex and Kraden?{end_wait}
We know nothing\nabout this Apollo Lens.{end_wait}
In Vale, you warned me\nabout thirty years.{end_wait}
Not every world\nfollows the same road.{end_wait}
You said he escaped.\nWhere did he go?{end_wait}
You can't expect me\nto forget his name!{end_wait}
We can ask about that\nanother time.{end_wait}
Vale is too close\nto risk leaving this open.{end_wait}
I need this passage\nlong enough to learn\nhow to open one safely.{end_wait}
Not at Vale's expense.\nWe're closing it.{end_wait}
You won't reach the anchor\nwhile I still stand here.{end_wait}
Stand beside me, Heart.\nAnd Isaac lives.{end_wait}
Yes, my lady.\nI won't fail you.{end_wait}
It's over.\nLet us seal the Rift.{end_wait}
I won't fight again.\nI've learned enough\nfrom this breach.{end_wait}
You followed my orders.\nLeave it at that.{end_wait}
If we seal that light,\nwhat happens to the rooms?{end_wait}
They may remain.\nBut nothing new\nwill be drawn in.{end_wait}
Safe from this opening.\nNot from every Rift.{end_wait}
You said Alex escaped.\nWhere is he now?{end_wait}
And the Grave Eclipse?\nYou said thirty years.{end_wait}
My warning stands.\nDon't mistake this Rift\nfor the end of it.{end_wait}
You still haven't\ntold me who you are.{end_wait}
She said it holds\nthe Rift open.{end_wait}
The room is still here.\nJust as she said.{end_wait}
I hope Vale is safe now.{end_wait}
She spoke of him as if\nall that had happened.{end_wait}
It may have happened\nin her world.{end_wait}
We should tell the elders\nwhat we've learned.{end_wait}
We'll look for him.\nLet's get out of here.{end_wait}
